title: c06: claim S,I,D,H on pcell-yield: a heritable particle link yield rises under selection by intrinsic starvation deaths of low-yield cells
summary: pcell with a continuous heritable link yield per catalyst particle (mutation 0.02 per duplication, step 0.05, no cost): mean yield 1.0 -> 1.46, 1.48 by t=100000 against a neutral twin (trait inert) at 1.12, 1.00; 58 and 47 whole-cell deaths sit at the 10th and 3rd yield percentile of living cells, the twin has 0-1 deaths. Next: labkit packs, then the claim.
